# AAPL 2024Q2: freshly recomputed growth under v3

Latest local assessment cutoff 2024-08-02T23:59:59+00:00; reconstructed with a later-authored local method, not a contemporaneous forecast. Retained original accession 0000320193-24-000069, period 2023-12-31 through 2024-03-30; economic publication 2024-05-03 is eligible at cutoff. No retrieval or method date establishes historical economic availability.

Revenue 90753000000 versus 94836000000 USD gives -4.305327090978% year-over-year growth. Gross profit 42271000000 versus 41976000000 USD gives current margin 46.578074554009%, prior margin 44.261672782488%, change 2.316401771522 percentage points. Calculations use dollar inputs afresh, never saved percentage outputs. See calculations.json for formulas, exact Decimal results, alternative arithmetic checks and product reconciliation. Quarter values are compared with prior-year quarter values; cumulative columns, EPS and average shares are not subtracted.

Revenue contraction coexists with higher margin. Product changes in USD millions are iPhone -5,371, Mac +283, iPad -1,111, Wearables/Home/Accessories -844 and Services +2,960: total -4,083. Greater China fell 1,440 million. Services offsets do not establish broad demand strength. Original MD&A attributes Services margin improvement to mix; currency and product volume oppose an inference of durable pricing power. These are management explanations, not independently isolated causes.

Original-page access does not retain raw HTML or verify the prior HTML hash. No full filing reading, raw-context validation, amendment inventory or fresh official filing-date check is claimed.

This new calculation/check/output supersedes affected growth, rather than rebinding old prose to v3. Q3 independent identity remains the exact predecessor unit.
